plugins.name: planning-kit
plugins.description: 모호한 아이디어를 심층 인터뷰로 명확화하고, 기획 초안 변환, 저장 파일 중심 결과 우선 리뷰, SSOT 감사, 정책서·기능 설계서를 v0.7 Confluence 후보 문서로 발행, AI가 쓴 한글 텍스트를 사람 글처럼 윤문하는 humanize-korean까지 지원하는 planning-kit.

plugins.name: dbml-kit
plugins.description: DBML schemas explained to non-developers, gap analysis against product specs, and Mermaid ERD rendering.

plugins.name: colonova-engineering-docs-kit
plugins.description: Continuous maintenance and freshness management for the 8.8 ColoNova Confluence tree via an audit→refresh loop: colonova-engineering-docs-audit builds the refresh/execution queues and colonova-engineering-docs-publish runs the updates from those page IDs. Covers routing, audit, freshness/staleness (living standards, 07 monitoring SLO/threshold pages, Approved design reviews, 09 living roadmaps), pending-supersession (05/08/12/ADR), incomplete-discussion-closure and new-subfolder-drift detection, single and batch refresh, supersession with inbound-link reconciliation, and approval-gated publishing skills.

plugins.name: xstate-kit
plugins.description: XState v5 toolkit: author typed state machines, generate model-based tests, wire React, and export machines to 14+ graph/diagram formats (Mermaid, DOT, Cytoscape, xyflow, GraphML, and more).

plugins.name: design-kit
plugins.description: Colosseum 브랜드 디자인 시스템 + 범용 UI 디자인 지능. '디자인 만들어줘'에 브랜드 일관 self-contained HTML(colosseum-design), 브랜드 무관 스타일·색·폰트·차트·UX 데이터 추천(ui-design-intelligence). Python·daemon·MCP 불필요.
